notes: An ijaza lineage of later scholars comes first, then the Saduq, who the text writes as a transmitter (rule 13), then the chain to Ali b. al-Husayn.
«زين الدين والدي» is one link named زين الدين; «والدي» is his relation to the speaker, not a second link.
«عمي علي بن العباس» is one link: the name alone (rule 7). Footnote numbers and blessings are left out.
